test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the given sentence have been given as options. One of them contains a grammatical error. Select the option that has the error.

India has produce many well-known scientists who have received accolades all over the world.
solution:
The correct answer is **India has produce.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence is in the **present perfect tense.**
 
• According to the **rule of the present perfect** tense, **the subject will be followed by "has" or "have"** followed by the **past participle form of the** **main verb.**
 
• Besid
